dedupe_keys.name: slcorsnet continuously operating gnss reference station network of sri lanka

description: SLCORSnet is the continuously operating GNSS reference station network of the Survey Department of Sri Lanka. It provides real-time GNSS corrections for centimetre-level positioning using virtual reference station, pseudo reference station, area correction parameter (FKP) and master auxiliary concept methods, live streaming of datum transformation parameters with standard RTCM, raw GNSS data from any physical reference station or virtual point in RINEX or virtual RINEX format through the GNWEB delivery service, an automatic online post-processing service (SSRPOST), and monitoring of connected GNSS devices. The site names land survey, construction, sewage, water supply, utilities, transportation, structural monitoring, disaster management and logistics as users. Access is through a user account, free to set up but authenticated by SLCORSnet, and services are paid by bank deposit to the Department of Survey, with GNWEB and SSRPOST free for the same period as a correction subscription. Caveats: coverage is currently the Western Province and surrounding areas as phase one, with the whole island and nearby sea planned, and payment is by manual deposit. Coverage is Sri Lanka. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and structural and ground deformation monitoring; related records are ESTPOS of Estonia and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
